prompts.tea: Create a production material texture for a small iPhone vinyl record skin. Square full-bleed 1024x1024 flat orthographic texture swatch, NOT a product photo, NOT a round disc. Material: realistic translucent sage/tea-green marbled pressed vinyl polymer, like a jade green colored vinyl record with cream pigment physically kneaded and stretched through the resin. Rich continuous organic material across the ENTIRE square including all edges: several scales of subtle translucent green cloudy sheets, milky ivory gossamer membranes, delicately feathered branching tendrils, a few irregular thicker pigment accumulations. Clear green regions interspersed with dense ivory, naturally uneven density and varied sharpness. Underlying green has soft yellow-sage tint (#A8BE93 to #819878), milk is warm ivory #F0EEDD. Soft diffuse transmitted light, calm retro feminine private-journal feeling. Strong enough texture contrast to remain legible when this whole swatch is cropped into a circular annulus and downsampled to 84 pixels, yet elegant and quiet. Texture must be distributed around the edges, NOT only in the center. NO straight graphic lines, NO isolated two white squiggles on a flat surface, NO big uniform white ribbons, NO gold, NO glitter, NO ink outlines, NO radial sunburst, NO cracks in a stone slab, NO photoreal lighting reflection or vignette. NO lettering, logos, person, album art, hole, central paper label, background, frame, or shadows. A flat material texture only; circle and transparent center will be applied by the app.
prompts.peach: Create a production material texture for a small iPhone vinyl record skin. Square full-bleed 1024x1024 flat orthographic texture swatch, NOT a product photo, NOT a round disc. Realistic translucent pink marbled pressed vinyl polymer inspired by beautiful pink-and-milky-white swirl colored LP records. Pale peach-pink translucent resin permeated with irregular wispy ivory pigment, stretched semi-transparent membranes, soft fibrous feathering, varied thin branching folds and a few small deeper muted berry-pink pigment blooms. The coloring is inside the plastic, not drawn on top. Continuous material texture spread across the ENTIRE square, especially all four edges: medium broad softly blended clouds, fine strands and local stronger marbling with irregular clear pink regions between. Balanced layering and visible color variation, not a uniform dusty pink fill. Base pale rose-peach #DCB9BC, ivory #F4ECE5, occasional muted berry rose #BC7E98; warm soft girlish vintage quality without neon saturation. Make the texture remain recognizably marbled when cropped into an annulus and shrunk to 84 pixels, with interesting detail around the edges rather than only center. Flat diffuse transmitted light, no metallic lighting, no vignette or shadows. NO isolated two white squiggles, NO equal-width decorative wavy lines, NO uniform swirly rings, NO giant opaque cream stripes, NO geological cracks, NO glitter or gold. NO text, logo, person, album art, hole, center label, round disc silhouette, backdrop or border. Texture only; the app will draw the transparent-center circle.
